Node.js builtins only, no external packages. ESM. Neither function mutates its arguments, and both return fresh plain objects.\n\nOptions: both functions take a final `opts` object, which may be omitted. `opts.now` is optional and defaults to `Date.now`; when present it must be a function or undefined, otherwise a `TypeError` with message `\"now must be a function or undefined\"` is thrown. A returned slot satisfies `end - start >= minDurationMs`, so a gap of exactly `minDurationMs` is included and shorter gaps are never returned; zero-length gaps never appear. With no intersecting intervals the whole effective window is the single candidate slot.\n\n\nNote: aim for a clean, readable implementation; correctness matters most."}],"timestamp":1794116396583}}
